content: Drizzle ORM (better-sqlite3 driver): drizzle-kit generate produces versioned SQL migration files from the TS schema; drizzle-kit migrate (or the embedded drizzle-orm/better-sqlite3/migrator migrate(db,{migrationsFolder}) function) applies them at runtime. push/pull commands exist for rapid prototyping but generate+migrate is the versioned-file workflow appropriate for a durable schema.
